First, I'd like to know if there were any lawsuits filed against the company 'TechCorp' in the location 'San Francisco' in the year 2018, specifically civil cases. Secondly, I'm planning a trip and need to check the availability of Hilton hotels in 'New York City' for the check-in date '2022-10-15' and check-out date '2022-10-20' for 2 adults. Could you assist me with these?"
